pr_title: Change default algorithms in PKCS12_create() and PKCS12_set_mac()
pr_body:
Use the modern defaults as now set in the pkcs12 app. This also
allows modifying the application to not override the default values
when calling the API.

Fixes #14034

issue_context.title: 3.0.0-alpha12-dev: PKCS12_create should not use legacy cyphers by default and demo pkwrite.c fails to run
issue_context.body:
Similar to https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/11672, `PKCS12_create` as per https://www.openssl.org/docs/manmaster/man3/PKCS12_create.html says

> The parameters `nid_key`, `nid_cert`, `iter`, `mac_iter` and `keytype` can all be set to zero and sensible defaults will be used.
>
> These defaults are: 40 bit RC2 encryption for certificates, triple DES encryption for private keys, a key iteration count of PKCS12_DEFAULT_ITER (currently 2048) and a MAC iteration count of 1.

These defaults differ from `openssl pkcs12` which were updated in https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/12540 use AES-256-CBC with PBKDF2 for key derivation.

The included `demos/pkcs12/pkwrite.c` program also fails to run in 3.0.0-alpha12-dev

Version: 
```
$ ./apps/openssl version -a
OpenSSL 3.0.0-alpha12-dev  (Library: OpenSSL 3.0.0-alpha12-dev )
built on: Mon Feb  1 07:00:05 2021 UTC
platform: darwin64-x86_64
options:  bn(64,64)
compiler: cc -fPIC -arch x86_64 -O3 -Wall -DL_ENDIAN -DOPENSSL_PIC -D_REENTRANT -DOPENSSL_BUILDING_OPENSSL -DNDEBUG
OPENSSLDIR: "/usr/local/ssl"
ENGINESDIR: "/usr/local/lib/engines-3"
MODULESDIR: "/usr/local/lib/ossl-modules"
Seeding source: os-specific
CPUINFO: OPENSSL_ia32cap=0x7ffaf3ffffebffff:0x40000000029c67af
```


Environment:
```bash
export OPENSSL_HOME=$HOME/git/github/openssl/openssl
export LIBRARY_PATH=$OPENSSL_HOME
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$OPENSSL_HOME
export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=$OPENSSL_HOME
export CPATH=$OPENSSL_HOME/include
```

Steps to reproduce:
```
$ gcc -o pkwrite -I$OPENSSL_HOME/include -L$OPENSSL_HOME -lcrypto demos/pkcs12/pkwrite.c
$ ./pkwrite apps/cert.pem 12345678 foobar out.p12
Error creating PKCS#12 structure
C0AD9F0C01000000:error:0308010C:digital envelope routines:inner_evp_generic_fetch:unsupported:crypto/evp/evp_fetch.c:331:Global default library context, Algorithm (RC2-40-CBC : 62), Properties ()
C0AD9F0C01000000:error:11800067:PKCS12 routines:PKCS12_item_i2d_encrypt:encrypt error:crypto/pkcs12/p12_decr.c:165:
C0AD9F0C01000000:error:11800067:PKCS12 routines:PKCS12_pack_p7encdata:encrypt error:crypto/pkcs12/p12_add.c:117:
```
comments:
Hmm, also seems that the MAC algorithm defaults to SHA-1, but there is no way in the PKCS12_create API to customise it unlike the `openssl pkcs12 -macalg <alg>` equivalent

https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7292#appendix-C it can be any of SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224, or SHA-512/256
OTC: decision to Change PKCS#12 creation to use AES-256-CBC and SHA-256 by default
Stupid iOS will fail to import p12 files from OpenSSL 3 due to this change. The workaround is to use `OpenSSL-1.1` for now.

> Stupid iOS will fail to import p12 files from OpenSSL 3 due to this change. The workaround is to use `OpenSSL-1.1` for now.

You can use -legacy option with the openssl pkcs12 command to revert to the legacy defaults.

review_comments: Shouldn't this change (also in in the doc) to `"sha256"`?
Fetch instead of the legacy implementation?
Possibly.  There is PR in progress #14474 making these changes.  @slontis, you close on that one?
There is no point in doing fetch as the md_type is used only to get a NID in the PKCS12_setup_mac().
